# costgraph_ai_gateway_integration (Resource)

Connect an AI gateway to collect token usage and associate reported models and sub-accounts with pricing and display names.

Requires an owner, admin, or billing admin API key with access to the tenant. To configure a newly created tenant, use an organization owner's key explicitly granted organization:manage.

A connection without a cluster or instance accepts pushed usage. Collection through a cluster or instance requires a running CostGraph collector registered in that tenant.

Destroying the resource disconnects the gateway and removes its ingested data from cost views. Advanced metric bindings and attribution rules remain managed outside this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costgraph_tenant" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

resource "costgraph_ai_gateway_integration" "inference" {
  tenant_id           = costgraph_tenant.production.id
  provider_name       = "agentgateway"
  provider_account_id = "production-inference"
  display_name        = "Production inference"

  tenant_map = {
    acme = "Acme"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_account_id` (String) Unique name for this gateway account in the tenant. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `provider_name` (String) Gateway identifier from the CostGraph integration catalog, such as agentgateway or envoy_ai_gateway. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Registered cluster UUID for operator collection. Conflicts with instance_id. Removing both scope fields switches the connection to pushed usage.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to provider_account_id. Omitting it after creation keeps the existing name.
- `instance_id` (String) Registered instance UUID for host-agent collection. Conflicts with cluster_id.
- `model_map` (Map of String) Map reported model names to canonical model keys from the CostGraph catalog. Aliases are not canonical keys. Defaults to an empty map. Removing an entry removes its mapping and can reprice recent usage.
- `scrape_label_selector` (String) Pod label selector for collection. Omit to use the gateway default. Required with cluster_id when the gateway has no default selector.
- `scrape_namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace to scrape. Omit to use the gateway default. Required with cluster_id when the gateway has no default namespace.
- `scrape_port` (Number) Metrics port from 1 through 65535. Omit to use the gateway default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase tenant UUID. Defaults to the API key's tenant. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `tenant_map` (Map of String) Map reported sub-account identifiers to display names. Defaults to an empty map. Removing an entry removes the display-name override.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection ID used for ingestion. Use id for import.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.
- `ingest_mode` (String) Collection mode. push accepts usage posted to the connection. telemetry collects through the configured cluster or instance.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_ai_gateway_integration.inference 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
